parameters.emailMessage/Subject: FAILED: RMG RML Offline MoreThan 44 Days as per the Redlands Data

parameters.specification/query:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name])),
			AND(
				NOT(SEARCH("PEAK", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name], 1, 0) >= 1),
				NOT(SEARCH("-", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name], 1, 0) >= 1)
			)
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"Offline"}, 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 44 Days])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({"Home/Lost_Stolen/Lost"}, 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Group Path])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable4 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Build])),
			SEARCH("LETTER", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Build], 1, 0) >= 1
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable5 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Address])),
			NOT(SEARCH("NDA", 'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Address], 1, 0) >= 1)
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable6 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Post Code])),
			NOT('Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Post Code] IN {""})
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable7 = 
		TREATAS({"Offline"}, 'Lost_RML_Offline_44Days_Redlands'[Offline > 44 Days])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				FILTER(
					KEEPFILTERS(
						SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
							'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name],
							'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[PEAK],
							'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Serial Number],
							'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[IMEI],
							'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 44 Days],
							'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[ICCID],
							'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Group Path],
							'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Build],
							'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Stock],
							'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Status],
							'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Asset No.],
							'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Last Seen],
							'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Address],
							'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Post Code],
							'Lost_RML_Offline_44Days_Redlands'[Date Last Used],
							'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 16 Days],
							'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[DOBI],
							'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[DeviceID],
							__DS0FilterTable,
							__DS0FilterTable2,
							__DS0FilterTable3,
							__DS0FilterTable4,
							__DS0FilterTable5,
							__DS0FilterTable6,
							__DS0FilterTable7,
							"CountRowsLost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears", COUNTROWS('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'),
							"CountRowsLost_Offline_44Days_X012", COUNTROWS('Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'),
							"CountRowsLost_RML_Offline_44Days_Redlands", COUNTROWS('Lost_RML_Offline_44Days_Redlands')
						)
					),
					OR(
						OR(
							OR(
								OR(
									OR(
										OR(
											OR(
												OR(
													OR(
														OR(
															OR(
																OR(
																	OR(
																		OR(
																			OR(
																				OR(
																					OR(
																						NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name])),
																						NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[PEAK]))
																					),
																					NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Serial Number]))
																				),
																				NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[IMEI]))
																			),
																			NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 44 Days]))
																		),
																		NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[ICCID]))
																	),
																	NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Group Path]))
																),
																NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Build]))
															),
															NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Stock]))
														),
														NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Status]))
													),
													NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Asset No.]))
												),
												NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Last Seen]))
											),
											NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Address]))
										),
										NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Post Code]))
									),
									NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_RML_Offline_44Days_Redlands'[Date Last Used]))
								),
								NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 16 Days]))
							),
							NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[DOBI]))
						),
						NOT(ISBLANK('Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[DeviceID]))
					)
				)
			),
			"'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name]", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name],
			"'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[PEAK]", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[PEAK],
			"'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Serial Number]", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Serial Number],
			"'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[IMEI]", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[IMEI],
			"'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 44 Days]", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 44 Days],
			"'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[ICCID]", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[ICCID],
			"'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Group Path]", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Group Path],
			"'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Build]", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Build],
			"'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Stock]", 'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Stock],

			"'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Last Seen]", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Last Seen],
			"'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Address]", 'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Address],
			"'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Post Code]", 'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[Post Code],
			"'Lost_RML_Offline_44Days_Redlands'[Date Last Used]", 'Lost_RML_Offline_44Days_Redlands'[Date Last Used],
			"'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 16 Days]", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 16 Days],
			"'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[DOBI]", 'Lost_Offline_44Days_X012'[DOBI],
			"'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[DeviceID]", 'Lost_Offline_GT44_Days_42Gears'[DeviceID]
		)

EVALUATE

ORDER BY

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: RML: ACTION REQUIRED: RML LOST Devices Offline > 44 days to be updated as WIPE
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Good morning,

Please see the list of devices that have been offline for at least 44 days, these devices will be wiped in 2 days if they are not powered up beforehand. After they have been wiped, if the affected sites locate their PDAs, please ask them to report an incident to the PDA Service Desk to request replacement of the PDAs.

@{outputs('Compose_Email')}
Many thanks,


RMG PDA Servicedesk L1
